trace.content: What brings you in today? Please describe your main symptoms and complaints.

[REFERENCE] 2. The patient has been brought in by his mother due to a significant change in his personality over the past 7 months.  
[REFERENCE] 3. He has become increasingly isolated, ceasing contact with family and friends.  
[REFERENCE] 4. The patient expresses a concern that aliens are watching him and stealing his thoughts.  
[REFERENCE] 5. Inability to leave the house.  
[REFERENCE] 6. Exhibits a flat affect.  
[REFERENCE] 7. Reports anxiety.  
[RESPONSE] I’ve been feeling really different for about seven months — my mom brought me in because I’ve withdrawn from everyone, stopped talking to family and friends, and I can’t even leave the house anymore. I feel like aliens are watching me and stealing my thoughts. I also feel anxious most of the time, and people have told me I seem emotionally flat — like I don’t show much expression.

DECISION: Somewhat Unconfident']
